title: Seagrove Beach 8BR Vacation Home with a Shared Pool
meta_description: Relax in this 8BR, 8BA vacation home in Seagrove Beach, with a communal pool, Xplorie benefits, and a five-minute walk to the beach. Sleeps 20.
description_expanded: A 4-bedroom, 4-bath home that sleeps 12 (Ocean Park) and a neighboring 4-bedroom, 4-bath home that sleeps 8 (Sea Echo), are located in the heart of Seagrove Beach in the beautiful and serine SeaNest Village community. This quaint, gated community backs up to a state forest, and is located just a short 5-minute walk from the gorgeous, white-sanded beaches.You can step out the back of both of these beach homes and explore the beauty while hiking on the nature trails and boardwalks thru the Cypress forest. With these, you will find wonderful amenities like a shared community pool, private commercial outdoor grill, and fire pit for late night enjoyment.Ocean Park Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 121st Floor, Bedroom 1: Bunkroom with full-over-full bunk, TV. Shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo1st Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks and large shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub and large shower.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV and private balcony. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub and large shower.3rd Floor, Landing: 2 twin beds.Sea Echo Sleeping Arrangements - Sleeps 81st Floor, Bedroom 1: 2 twin beds, TV. Shared hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo.1st Floor, Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV. Private bathroom with large shower.2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: King bed, TV, balcony access. Private bathroom with soaking tub and shower.3rd Floor, Bedroom 4: King bed, TV. Private bathroom with dual sinks, soaking tub, and shower.Beach Access:Exit out the neighborhood to 30A and cross the street to the bike path. Walk towards the right and you will see the gate at Sea Turtle Dr for your deeded beach access, utilizing the one security fob provided at the home.Distance: .2 miles | Time: 4 minutes walkingSeaNest Village:SeaNest Village is a gated community directly off 30A. This quaint neighborhood offers peace and privacy. The subdivision is bordered by Point Washington State Forest to the north. The community pool is breathtaking with its waterfall edge and cool blue tile. There is plenty of room to splash around on both levels. Relax on a lounger or at one of the cocktail tables. Head up to the observation deck to catch a great sunset.Your stay at Sea Echo + Ocean Park comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 2 cars in each driveway with passes; parking for additional 2 cars in garage.* Benchmark cannot guarantee/service owner-provided amenities* Please note, there is ongoing construction in this neighborhoodAn initial starter kit of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
